facts.fact: Digital transition minister Aminata Zerbo told parliament that three AI projects were being finalised in her department: the DJAM platform, a chatbot on electronic communications regulation and a chatbot on Burkina's legislative texts.
facts.system: DJAM; chatbot on electronic communications regulation; chatbot on legislative texts

BFA.note: No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
An AI action plan is only announced for 2025, with no drafting stated; the national digital strategy under revision is not an AI strategy.

facts.fact: The minister told parliament that the digital transition ministry was finalising the DJAM AI engine for analysing threats to social cohesion in text and audio, and two chatbots, one on communications regulation and one on legislation built on LegiBurkina.

BFA.note: The national backbone is mentioned as an action engaged, with no contract, works or service stated.
